meta.title: Barcoder – Encyclopedia of QR & Barcode Standards | LumiVerse
meta.description: Barcoder catalogues 463 QR, barcode and visual-code standards across 197 countries, cross-referenced with the 1,076 wallets that read them.

en.title: Barcoder
en.subtitle: Scan a payment QR in Zagreb and one in Manila and you're looking at two unrelated standards. Barcoder catalogues all of them – 463 visual-code standards across 197 countries, cross-referenced with the 1,076 wallets that read them.

showcase.alt: Barcoder landing page showing the catalogue counts: 463 standards, 197 countries, 1,076 wallets and 112 sample codes

stats.label: Real sample codes to test against

sections.title: Nobody Wrote This Down
sections.lede: The answers live in central bank announcements, ISO/IEC specs, scheme documentation, vendor PDFs and regulator filings – in a dozen languages, none of them talking to each other. Barcoder pulls them into one cross-referenced place.

items.title: The Questions It Answers
items.body:
Which QR standard does this country's instant-payment scheme use?
Will this wallet scan a merchant code from that scheme?
What's actually inside this payload I just decoded?
How do two national schemes interoperate at the counter?

items.title: Who Reads It
items.body:
Payments engineers integrating a new market. Fintech teams sizing wallet coverage before launch. Wallet providers checking which rails they can ride. Researchers who need a citation, not a forum post.

Every page names its sources. Vol. I, Edition 2026 – and it grows with each commit.

sections.title: Three Ways In
sections.lede: Every entry links to the others. Start from a standard, a country, or a wallet – you end up in the same graph.

items.title: Standards
items.body:
Every QR, barcode and visual-code specification we can find evidence for – EMV merchant-presented modes, national instant-payment QRs, retail GS1 codes, niche transit codes.

463 entries, A to Z
PIX, UPI, KHQR, Bharat QR, EAN-13, Code 128

items.title: Payments by Country
items.body:
A page per country covering which schemes operate there, what visual codes those schemes use, and how interoperability works at the merchant counter.

197 countries, no gaps
Scheme, code and rail on one page

items.title: Wallets
items.body:
One page per wallet – GCash, Alipay, Revolut, M-Pesa and the rest – covering which standards each supports, in which markets, and against which underlying rails.

1,076 wallet profiles
Market and rail coverage per wallet

sections.title: Point It At a Code
sections.lede: A reference book you can run. Scan a code, paste a payload, or generate one – and land on the standard that explains it.

items.title: Identification, Not Just Decoding
items.body:
Plenty of tools read a QR code. Barcoder tells you what it is. Decoded payloads are matched against all 463 standards and 1,076 wallets using URI schemes, TLV structures (EMVCo MPM), contact formats and payment-scheme identifiers.

Payment QRs: PIX, UPI, PromptPay, SGQR, DuitNow
Bank transfers: HUB3, SEPA EPC, Swiss QR-bill
Crypto URIs, vCard, MECARD, WiFi, calendar
Every match links to its reference page

items.title: Camera Scan
items.body: Point your phone at a code in the wild. Decode and identify in the browser – no app to install.

items.title: Paste & Decode
items.body: Drop in a raw payload string. Get the matching standard and every field broken out and labelled.

items.title: Sample Gallery
items.body: 112 real codes from schemes around the world. Test your own parser against something authentic.

items.title: Encoder Playground
items.body: 40 encoders. Fill in the form, generate a valid code, then scan it back – all on one page.

sections.title: The Content Is the Repo
sections.lede: Every page on Barcoder is rendered from a single markdown file checked into the repository. No CMS. No admin backend. No production-only edits.

items.title: Research
items.body: Each country starts as long-form research – central bank sources, scheme docs, regulator filings, read and written up.
items.label: reports/

items.title: Extract
items.body: Claude Code skills pull structured per-standard and per-country pages out of that research, consistently every time.
items.label: .claude/skills/

items.title: Commit
items.body: Pages land as markdown in the repo. Every published claim is traceable to the commit that introduced it.
items.label: docs/

items.title: Render
items.body: The backend reads those files, the frontend renders them. Boring on purpose – and reproducible from source.
items.label: web

items.title: Auditable by Design
items.body: A reference work is only worth as much as its sourcing. Because the content is the repo, any page can be traced back through git to the change that wrote it – and corrected the same way anyone corrects code.

items.title: One Person, Encyclopedic Scope
items.body: 197 country reports is a research-team-year of work. AI agents did the extraction and drafting; a human set the structure, checked the sources and shipped it. That's the whole LumiVerse thesis in one project.

closing.title: Have a Domain Nobody Mapped?
closing.body: Barcoder is what happens when you point AI research pipelines at a scattered field and make every output auditable. The same approach works on your industry's mess.

hr.title: Barcoder
hr.subtitle: Skenirajte platni QR u Zagrebu i jedan u Manili i gledate dva nepovezana standarda. Barcoder ih katalogizira sve — 463 vizualna kodna standarda iz 197 zemalja, unakrsno povezana s 1.076 novčanika koji ih čitaju.

showcase.alt: Naslovnica Barcodera s brojkama iz kataloga: 463 standarda, 197 zemalja, 1.076 novčanika i 112 primjera kodova

stats.label: Zemalja s izvještajima o platnim shemama

sections.title: Nitko ovo nije zapisao
sections.lede: Odgovori žive u objavama središnjih banaka, ISO/IEC specifikacijama, dokumentaciji shema, PDF-ovima dobavljača i regulatornim podnescima — na desetak jezika i međusobno nepovezani. Barcoder ih skuplja na jedno unakrsno povezano mjesto.

items.title: Pitanja na koja odgovara
items.body:
Koji QR standard koristi shema instantnih plaćanja u ovoj zemlji?
Hoće li ovaj novčanik skenirati trgovački kod iz te sheme?
Što se zapravo nalazi u ovom payloadu koji sam upravo dekodirao?
Kako dvije nacionalne sheme surađuju na blagajni?

items.title: Tko ga čita
items.body:
Inženjeri plaćanja koji integriraju novo tržište. Fintech timovi koji prije lansiranja procjenjuju pokrivenost novčanicima. Pružatelji novčanika koji provjeravaju na koje se infrastrukture mogu osloniti. Istraživači kojima treba citat, a ne objava s foruma.

Svaka stranica navodi svoje izvore. Svezak I., izdanje 2026. — i raste sa svakim commitom.

sections.title: Tri ulaza
sections.lede: Svaki unos vodi na ostale. Krenete od standarda, zemlje ili novčanika — završite u istom grafu.

items.title: Standardi
items.body:
Svaka QR, barkod i vizualna kodna specifikacija za koju možemo pronaći dokaz — EMV načini koje prikazuje trgovac, nacionalni QR-ovi za instantna plaćanja, maloprodajni GS1 kodovi, rijetki kodovi za javni prijevoz.

463 unosa, od A do Ž
PIX, UPI, KHQR, Bharat QR, EAN-13, Code 128

items.title: Plaćanja po zemljama
items.body:
Stranica po zemlji: koje sheme ondje rade, koje vizualne kodove te sheme koriste i kako izgleda međusobna suradnja na blagajni.

197 zemalja, bez rupa
Shema, kod i infrastruktura na jednoj stranici

items.title: Novčanici
items.body:
Stranica po novčaniku — GCash, Alipay, Revolut, M-Pesa i ostali — koje standarde podržava, na kojim tržištima i preko koje infrastrukture.

1.076 profila novčanika
Pokrivenost tržišta i infrastrukture po novčaniku

sections.title: Uperite ga u kod
sections.lede: Priručnik koji se može pokrenuti. Skenirajte kod, zalijepite payload ili ga generirajte — i završite na standardu koji ga objašnjava.

items.title: Prepoznavanje, ne samo dekodiranje
items.body:
Mnogi alati pročitaju QR kod. Barcoder Vam kaže što on jest. Dekodirani payloadi uspoređuju se sa svih 463 standarda i 1.076 novčanika pomoću URI shema, TLV struktura (EMVCo MPM), kontaktnih formata i identifikatora platnih shema.

Platni QR-ovi: PIX, UPI, PromptPay, SGQR, DuitNow
Bankovni prijenosi: HUB3, SEPA EPC, Swiss QR-bill
Kripto URI-ji, vCard, MECARD, WiFi, kalendar
Svako podudaranje vodi na svoju referentnu stranicu

items.title: Skeniranje kamerom
items.body: Uperite mobitel u kod na terenu. Dekodiranje i prepoznavanje u pregledniku — bez instaliranja aplikacije.

items.title: Zalijepite i dekodirajte
items.body: Ubacite sirovi payload. Dobijete standard koji mu odgovara i svako polje razloženo i označeno.

items.title: Galerija primjera
items.body: 112 stvarnih kodova iz shema diljem svijeta. Testirajte vlastiti parser na nečemu autentičnom.

items.title: Igralište za enkodere
items.body: 40 enkodera. Ispunite obrazac, generirajte valjan kod pa ga skenirajte natrag — sve na jednoj stranici.

sections.title: Sadržaj je repozitorij
sections.lede: Svaka se stranica Barcodera prikazuje iz jedne markdown datoteke u repozitoriju. Bez CMS-a. Bez administratorskog sučelja. Bez izmjena koje postoje samo u produkciji.

items.title: Istraživanje
items.body: Svaka zemlja počinje kao opsežno istraživanje — izvori središnje banke, dokumentacija shema, regulatorni podnesci, pročitano i zapisano.
items.label: reports/

items.title: Izdvajanje
items.body: Claude Code vještine iz tog istraživanja izvlače strukturirane stranice po standardu i po zemlji, svaki put jednako.
items.label: .claude/skills/

items.title: Commit
items.body: Stranice slijeću u repozitorij kao markdown. Svaka objavljena tvrdnja može se pratiti do commita koji ju je uveo.
items.label: docs/

items.title: Prikaz
items.body: Backend čita te datoteke, frontend ih prikazuje. Dosadno namjerno — i ponovljivo iz izvora.
items.label: web

items.title: Provjerljivo od temelja
items.body: Referentno djelo vrijedi onoliko koliko i njegovi izvori. Budući da je sadržaj repozitorij, svaka se stranica kroz git može pratiti do izmjene koja ju je napisala — i ispraviti isto onako kako se ispravlja kod.

items.title: Jedna osoba, enciklopedijski opseg
items.body: 197 izvještaja o zemljama godina je rada istraživačkog tima. AI agenti su izdvajali i pisali nacrte, čovjek je postavio strukturu, provjerio izvore i objavio. To je cijela teza LumiVersea u jednom projektu.

closing.title: Imate područje koje nitko nije mapirao?
closing.body: Barcoder je ono što nastane kad AI istraživačke pipeline usmjerite na rasuto područje i svaki izlaz učinite provjerljivim. Isti pristup radi i na neredu u Vašoj industriji.
